description: Batch IP lookup for log analysis and fraud review: up to 10 IPv4 or IPv6 addresses per call, 40% cheaper than singles. JSON body {ips:[...]}. Each item returns the owning network, range, country (RDAP) and reverse DNS. Bad items return per-item errors. Price $0.012 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"count":2,"succeeded":2,"failed":0,"results":[{"input":"1.1.1.1","ok":true,"result":{"network":"APNIC-LABS","country":"AU"}},{"input":"8.8.8.8","ok":true,"result":{"network":"GOGL","country":"US"}}]}
name: ip_lookup_batch
